title: message digest mismatch uses SmimeError::Other instead of appropriate variant
description: verify.rs line 303: a message-digest mismatch (content was tampered) returns SmimeError::Other('message digest mismatch'). This is a string-wrapped error that callers cannot programmatically distinguish from other Other(...) messages. It is semantically a signature verification failure and would be better expressed via SmimeError::SignatureVerification (if that variant is kept) or via the structured error path. Low impact since the error is captured inside SignerResult.error as a string anyway — it does not surface as a top-level Err return.
close_reason: Opinion: SignatureVerification is now used for digest mismatch (MIME-qlt.3 fix). Variant name is correct for the failure semantics.
